items.prompt: Derive prefix formula, tie index and one-floor rule.
items.modelAnswer: P[k] is the exact prior-tier numerator. bisect_left finds the first bound >= V, or len(bounds) for the final tier. Let lower be the previous bound or 0. Add (V-lower)*rate[k], then floor once after dividing by 1000000. At a boundary, left search uses the full current tier; right search could use the next tier at zero width only with its matching prefix. Charge each marginal slice at its own rate, not the final rate on all volume.
